newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM Oct, Dec, Apr palladium futures tumble.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM Oct, Dec, Apr palladium futures tumble.

text.p: Yen-based October, December and April palladium futures tumbled by the 22 yen per gram daily limit at the opening on Monday, due to the expected resumption of Russia's exports of platinum group metals (PGM) to Japan, traders said.
Benchmark April palladium opened at 559 yen per gram and then recovered to 561 yen. Activity in palladium futures was heavy in early morning trade.
"As the Russia-Japan export contract talks of PGM for 1997 were set in early June, long-liquidation and fresh selling battered palladium," an analyst at a commodity broker said.

"Private investors, who still held massive short positions in TOCOM palladium futures, may also try to cover their shorts on the price dip, which may stem the fall. But overall sentiment in palladium is bearish," the analyst said.
